## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

WatchRaceNavigator — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/WatchRaceNavigator.kt

## Trigger

The lazy initialisation of `mutableCurrent`, first access to `current`
after a cold start, when `raceInProgress()` resolves true — observed

## Today

In `WatchRaceNavigator.kt` (`mutableCurrent`, the `lazy` block,
`:47-64`), the async check launched on `scope` writes
`WatchDestination.MAIN` directly as soon as `raceInProgress()` is
true, without touching `ExerciseSessionManager` in any way. No
Health Services session is opened, no sensor callback registered.

The only place that opens a session on resume is
`RaceLaunchController.openPreparation()`
(app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/RaceLaunchController.kt,
`:36-49`), reached exclusively from `PreparationViewModel`
(app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/preparation/PreparationViewModel.kt,
`:64`). `WatchRaceNavigator` writing `MAIN` directly bypasses
`PreparationViewModel` entirely, so `openPreparation()` — and with it
`reconcileResumedSession()` (`:75-82`), the private method that reopens
a resumed race's session and logs its outcome — is never called on
this path.

`WatchRaceNavigator`'s constructor takes only three suspend closures —
`sensorPermissionGranted`, `profileAlreadySynced`, `raceInProgress` —
none of which reaches `ExerciseSessionManager` or
`RaceLaunchController`. `NavigationModule.provideWatchRaceNavigator`
(app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/di/NavigationModule.kt,
`:34-55`) wires `raceInProgress` to a plain
`raceRecordingRepository.findInProgress()` read; it does not inject
`RaceLaunchController` or `ExerciseSessionManager` either. Nothing on
this call chain is in reach of the reopening logic.

## Expected

When the cold-resume check finds a race in progress, the session is
reopened before (or as part of) writing `WatchDestination.MAIN`, the
same way `RaceLaunchController.reconcileResumedSession()` does it for
the warm-resume path: adopt a session this application already owns,
log a `DeviceSlotTaken` or `Failed` outcome at ERROR without blocking
navigation (TECHNICAL_CONVENTIONS.md R79).

`reconcileResumedSession()` is private today and reachable only from
`openPreparation()`, itself reachable only from `PreparationViewModel`
— out of `WatchRaceNavigator`'s reach. `RaceLaunchController` needs a
method exposed for this cold-resume use, and `WatchRaceNavigator`
needs a new suspend closure to call it, wired in
`NavigationModule.provideWatchRaceNavigator` the same way
`raceInProgress` is wired today — bounded by a timeout consistent with
R19, since it runs before `WatchDestination.MAIN` is written and a
value must still be produced on failure.
